title: Frequency-Adaptive Dilated Convolution for Semantic Segmentation
mechanism: Per-pixel dilation rate set from local frequency content; AdaKern balances low / high kernel parts; FreqSelect damps high frequency in background regions.
adaptation: Put FADC + FreqSelect in ResNet-34 layer3/4 at output stride 16. FreqSelect could learn to damp the finger frequency band away from defects.
min_experiment: Arm: PF + FADC in layer3/4, 5 seeds. Baseline: PF. Metric: crack IoU, gridline IoU. Kill: crack IoU < +0.012.
evidence: R: gains on semantic segmentation and detection (abstract); numbers not read.
